Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (FinovateBank)

Hi Elena / Samir —

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Decision criteria you mentioned: latency under 200ms for customer-facing flows, strict token retention rules, and predictable monthly spend for FY27.
2) Key stakeholders we identified on the call:
   - Economic buyer: Samir Patel (Finance) — needs clear unit economics and ROI case.
   - Security lead: Elena Torres (Information Security) — will own SOC2 evidence + data residency discussion.
   - Procurement: TBD (legal procurement team owns PO/contract cadence).
   - Product champion: Priya (product/ops) — championing the use-case internally.

Attachments: I uploaded a quick stakeholder matrix and our SOC2 snapshot for Elena. Please see the attachments and the matrix where I listed recommended asks for each stakeholder.

Proposed next steps:
- Rishi & I will draft a one-page ROI talk track for Samir by Wednesday (10/07).
- Elena, can you confirm if a self-hosted Private deployment or Dedicated reserved capacity is required for your data residency?
- Samir, can we schedule a 30m follow-up next week to run through the unit economics and procurement timeline?

Open question for the internal team: Monica, can you prepare the typical contract cadence (SLA + procurement timeline) we see with banks of this size?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Strategic Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finovatebank.com>

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (FinovateBank)

Thanks Marissa — solid recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Data residency: for this initial pilot we can do Dedicated in us-west with contractual guarantees, but for full production we will likely require Private (VPC) to keep logs inside our network. I can confirm exact controls after I talk to infra (target this week).
- Procurement: Samir will lead, but procurement will require a standard vendor assessment. Can you send the up-to-date SOC2 report and any penetration test summaries? The SOC2 snapshot you attached is a good start.
- Decision timeline: Samir is aiming to include this in the vendor shortlist by 10/20; final decision by the end of November.

Quick ask: could you provide a one-pager ROI example (annualized cost savings + latency benefit) tailored to a 5M monthly API token volume? That would help Samir justify the economic case.

Appreciate it —
Elena Torres
Head of Information Security, FinovateBank
elena.torres@finovatebank.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ROI talk track + procurement bullets (for Samir)

Marissa / Monica —

Notes and a quick talk track I drafted for Samir (will send final one-pager to Elena & Samir after you review):

1) ROI headline: For 5M tokens/month, Redwood Dedicated reduces per-token cost by ~37% vs. on-demand public endpoints when using batching + KV caching; expected annualized savings in the sample are ~ $230k (includes reserved capacity discounts).
2) Latency/UX: Default Redwood config hits median tail latency ~120–150ms for 512-token flows on our Dedicated profile; this meets their 200ms target with headroom for spikes.
3) Procurement bullets:
   - Standard terms: 60-day SLA remediation + operational runbook.
   - Security: SOC2 Type II report (attached), penetration test summary on request, option for private VPC deployment and customer-managed KMS.
   - Contract cadence: Pilot PO -> 90-day pilot -> performance review -> annual contract for Dedicated/Private.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you include a short line quantifying expected call abandonment reduction (or conversion lift) tied to the latency improvement? Even a conservative 2% conversion uplift estimate will help the finance team.
- Monica: please add the procurement lead time and typical legal review milestones (we need the likely procurement contact name placeholder for the matrix).

I'll merge this into the one-pager and share before EOD.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive Manager, Redwood Inference
